observations: The page number «XIII» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature line of the printed sheet: «D. K. D. Vidensk. Selsk. Skr., 7. Række, hist. og filos. Afd. III. 1.» on the left and the sheet number «III» on the right; recorded here, not transcribed as a line.

L25-L28: the passage of Hermannus Dalmata is quoted in italics, the names in it («Albatene», «Alchoarismus», «Roberti») spaced in roman type. L01-L03: Robert's Latin renderings of the Arabic terms of C and O: dakaicae minuta, eltheniae secunda, elwacat medius cursus, tadil coaequatio, elgeib sinus, elfelek elmustakim circulus aequatorialis or aequinoctialis.
Marks not transcribed: a dark speck below the m of «quidem» (L26) and one between «mei» and «industria» (L27); a light mark after «Lateinische» (N01).
